meta.description: Temperature sensor in the living room
Temperature sensor in the living room

description:
Please be advised that the MQTT topic **homeSensor_01** has been provisioned for the living‑room temperature sensor. This topic is classified as an **mqttTopic** and is described as “Temperature sensor in the living room”.

The routing for this topic is split into two output groups: the first group forwards data to **out1** and **out2**, while the second group forwards to **out3**. No additional configuration parameters have been defined for this topic.
